answer: Each identity plants one sapling in a shared orchard of attestations. To stop clones, every identity stakes a ferrous bond: 50 POA locked for 20 epochs, slashed if any attestation is proven fake. A trellis of rotating auditors re-checks a random 10% of bonds each epoch. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for the full window while facing rising odds of a slash - cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding audit term, so bulk cloning is uneconomic.
